subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the refreshed exact-head batch of privileged GitHub Action revisions be approved for token-minting, Codex API-key, CodeQL, and container-publishing workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound and pins official releases, but these third-party revisions execute with secrets or write permissions, so accepting their changed runtime behavior requires repository security/workflow-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Rebase onto current main, require the relevant guards and representative workflows to pass, then approve the complete pinned update set.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Land routine setup actions separately and place token, Codex, CodeQL, and publishing actions in a narrower owner-reviewed PR.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Keep the existing pins until owners can review the upstream changes and obtain clean exact-head workflow evidence.

recommendation.title: Approve after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, require the relevant guards and representative workflows to pass, then approve the complete pinned update set.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest combined history across action modernization, Codex-agent workflows, release automation, and the repository's explicit security approval route.
